title: German Academic Scholarship Foundation: Scholarships for Students
summary: Scholarships for full-time students at state or state-recognised higher education institutions in Germany or the EU/Switzerland with exceptional talent, academic records, and community commitment.

degree_levels.notes: Sponsorship is open to all degree programmes and all types of higher education institutions. Second, additional, further or postgraduate studies are not eligible, but a consecutive Master's programme that follows a completed Bachelor's programme does not count as such.

subject_areas.notes: Sponsorship is open to all degree programmes.

values: state or state-recognised higher education institution (university, university of applied sciences, college of art and music) in Germany
higher education institution in a member state of the European Union (EU) or in Switzerland
institutions.notes: Applies to state or state-recognised institutions in Germany, EU, or Switzerland.

nationality.notes: Students with German citizenship or students who acquired higher education entrance qualification in Germany, individuals entitled to permanent residence or settlement in Germany, asylum seekers, recognised refugees, subsidiary protection, tolerated individuals after 15 months, EU citizens studying permanently in Germany seeking a degree, and countries listed in the selection dropdown.

residence.notes: Covers studies in Germany, EU member states, or Switzerland.

mandatory.text: Course of study at a state or state-recognised higher education institution in Germany or a member state of the EU or Switzerland
Meet requirements of §§ 8 Para. 1 to 3 or 61 BAföG, or EU/accession candidate citizens studying permanently in Germany for a degree
Only full-time studies can be funded

exceptions.text: Second, additional, further or postgraduate studies are not eligible, but a consecutive Master's programme following a Bachelor's is eligible.

funding.description: Allowance toward cost of study of 300 EUR and an income-dependent grant calculated per BAföG regulations. Additional allowances for scholars with children, health, and nursing care insurance.

application_rounds.notes: Deadlines vary depending on the selection procedure and can be found on the homepage.

steps.text: Students can apply themselves or be nominated by school administration, examination office, or lecturers.

sources.title: German Academic Scholarship Foundation: Scholarships for Students - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: The programme funds students completing studies at a higher education institution in Germany, meeting international student and residency eligibility pathways specified.
